MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '11006-1'})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, max(inv.version) AS max_version
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(current_inv:Inventory)
WHERE current_inv.version = max_version
WITH s, current_inv
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(v1_inv:Inventory)
WHERE v1_inv.version = 1
WITH current_inv, v1_inv

// Get all parts in current inventory (at any level, excluding spare parts, ignoring colours)
MATCH p = (current_inv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*0..6]->()-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->()-[:HAS_PART*1..6 (r, n | WHERE r.is_spare = false)]->(part_current:Part)
WITH current_inv, v1_inv, part_current, 
     list_product(properties(rels(p), 'qty')) AS qty_current
WITH current_inv, v1_inv, part_current.part_num AS part_num_current, sum(qty_current) AS total_current
WHERE total_current > 0
WITH current_inv, v1_inv, collect(DISTINCT part_num_current) AS current_parts

// Get all parts in version 1 inventory (at any level, excluding spare parts, ignoring colours)
MATCH p = (v1_inv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*0..6]->()-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->()-[:HAS_PART*1..6 (r, n | WHERE r.is_spare = false)]->(part_v1:Part)
WITH current_parts, part_v1, 
     list_product(properties(rels(p), 'qty')) AS qty_v1
WITH current_parts, part_v1.part_num AS part_num_v1, sum(qty_v1) AS total_v1
WHERE total_v1 > 0
WITH current_parts, collect(DISTINCT part_num_v1) AS v1_parts

// Find parts in current but not in v1
UNWIND current_parts AS cp
WITH cp, v1_parts
WHERE NOT cp IN v1_parts
RETURN cp AS part_num
ORDER BY cp
